guide.title: Understanding the results
guide.exitsQuestion: Why can domestic and overseas exits differ?
guide.exitsAnswer: Different destinations can use different network or proxy routes, so their public IP addresses may differ. Results can change when your network or proxy changes.
guide.locationAnswer: IP geolocation is a provider’s estimate for an address, not the device’s precise location. Provider and region details may also differ or be out of date.
guide.latencyAnswer: It is the time taken by a browser check to a target. Network conditions, the browser and the target affect it; it is not a measure of bandwidth or server processing time.
